lines: Woh humsafar tha magar us se humnawai na thi
couplets.en: He shared my road, though we never found a common voice.

lines: Woh humsafar tha
couplets.en: He was my travelling companion.

lines: Jis kaaran main jogan bani
couplets.en: It was for him that I took to wandering.

lines: Adaavatein theen, taghaaful tha, ranjishein theen magar
couplets.en: There was bitterness, indifference, and hurt, and yet.

lines: Bichharne waale mein sab kuchh tha, bewafai na thi
couplets.en: The one who left had every fault but faithlessness.

lines: Kaajal daaroon, kurkura surma saha na jaaye
couplets.en: I put on kohl, but its grit is more than my eyes can bear.

lines: Bichharte waqt un aankhon mein thi hamaari ghazal
couplets.en: At parting, our ghazal was there in his eyes.

lines: Ghazal bhi woh jo kisi ko kabhi sunai na thi
couplets.en: It was the ghazal I had never recited to anyone.

lines: Ajeeb hoti hai raah-e-sukhan bhi, dekh Naseer
couplets.en: See, Naseer, how strange the road of poetry can be.

lines: Wahaan bhi aa gaye aakhir jahaan rasaai na thi
couplets.en: In the end, we reached even the place that lay beyond our reach.
